answer_1.quote: We explore various techniques to develop an efficient alternative to the state-of-theart xCOMET metric for evaluating MT quality.
answer_1.outputs: translation hypotheses, segment-level quality scores, token-level error span annotations

answer_2.quote: We use the Kendall correlation to evaluate the quality of the compared metrics.

answer_3.quote: We use the teacher model to generate pseudo‑labels for a large dataset of text triplets. Specifically, the teacher model assigns segment‑level quality scores, q ∈ [0,1], and token‑level error span annotations.
criteria: error span categories (critical, major, minor, no‑error)
